17 likes, 0 comments - navyanaveli on September 28, 2026: "If tomorrow I am gone…

No more mad woman pestering you guys to study, rest, or take care of yourselves…

No more drunk laughters filling the quiet corners of the house…

No more habits that used to annoy you…

But also no more me happily carrying your emotional weight…

No more surprise visits to your room asking chking on you just like that…
No more acts of love that often go unnoticed…

REMEMBER ONE DAY, these ordinary moments may- will become memories. And regret often arrives too late.".

41 likes, 4 comments - navyanaveli on September 7, 2026: "Celebrating your birthday with you since 2001 ❤️
From being my boyfriend to becoming my husband, you’ve been my constant through every chapter, every version, and every season of my life. You’ve stood beside me through my happiest moments and my hardest days, through my dreams, my fears, my craziness, and everything in between.
I couldn’t have asked for a better person to laugh with, grow with, fight with, dream with, and do this beautiful, crazy life with. ❤️
Happy Birthday, Jaanu. 🥂❤️
Here’s to all the years behind us, all the memories yet to be made, and to us—always. ❤️".
